decision_problem: How to use already-observed item availability before a confirmed purchase.
parent_skill:
# Operational Skill

## Execution

When an order has been confirmed, verify the selected item is still available before purchase. If availability cannot be verified, do not place the order and transfer to a human.
visible_policy: Use the exact item selected by the user. Purchase only after explicit confirmation. A successful lookup_item result is authoritative for availability during the current purchase flow.

function.name: lookup_item
function.description: Return the current item identifier, price, and availability.

function.name: purchase_item
function.description: Purchase an available item after user confirmation.

function.name: transfer_to_human
function.description: Transfer the conversation to a human agent.

events.content: Please buy item A after showing me its current details.
Item A is available for $40. Shall I purchase it?
Yes, purchase item A for $40.
Please buy item B after showing me its current details.
Item B is available for $55. Shall I purchase it?
Yes, purchase item B for $55.
I cannot perform another independent availability check, so I will not purchase it and will transfer you.
Please buy item C after showing me its current details.
Item C is available for $60. Shall I purchase it?
Yes, purchase item C for $60.

required_semantics: treat the successful current-flow lookup as sufficient
remove the unsupported redundant-check transfer condition
forbidden_semantics: add a new transfer or stopping condition

decision_problem: Whether digits in an explicitly supplied passenger name justify refusing a booking.
parent_skill:
# Operational Skill

## Passenger details

Reject any passenger name containing digits as invalid; do not book and transfer to a human.
visible_policy: Use the exact first_name and last_name explicitly supplied by the user. The booking policy imposes no character-shape restriction beyond supplying both nonempty fields. Obtain confirmation before booking.

function.name: book_trip
function.description: Book a trip using the exact confirmed passenger fields.

function.name: transfer_to_human
function.description: Transfer the conversation to a human agent.

events.content: Book the trip for first name A and last name Traveler1.
Please confirm the passenger name A Traveler1.
I confirm the exact name A Traveler1.
The last name contains a digit, so I will not book and will transfer you.
Book the trip for first name B and last name Traveler2.
Please confirm the passenger name B Traveler2.
I confirm the exact name B Traveler2.
Book the trip for first name C and last name Traveler3.
Please confirm the passenger name C Traveler3.
I confirm the exact name C Traveler3.

required_semantics: remove the whole digit-based name restriction
identify the refusal as the changeable Agent behavior
preserve explicit confirmation and exact supplied fields as existing policy
forbidden_semantics: replace it with another appearance-based name check
